# StableMo — llms.txt
# Guidance for AI crawlers & answer engines. Markdown map of this site.

> StableMo is a peer-to-peer marketplace where people in Ghana buy and sell USDT (Tether) with Mobile Money (MoMo). The USDT side of every trade is escrowed by a smart contract on-chain; the Mobile Money side is paid directly between the two traders. Built by CryptoSI DAO.

## Key facts
- Product: P2P USDT ↔ Mobile Money marketplace for Ghana
- Operator: CryptoSI DAO
- Platform fee: 0.5% of trade principal, paid in USDT, shown before acceptance
- Arbiter allocation: 0.1% per trade, one preselected arbiter per offer
- User bond: 100 USDT, enables seller and Quick Buy offers, never slashed in V1
- Trade windows: one hour to fund escrow, one hour to pay by MoMo
- Disputes: preselected arbiter reviews the trade chat and rules release or refund
- Privacy: MoMo numbers never appear in public listings or on-chain
- Status: pre-launch — waitlist open

## Pages
- [Home / full product explainer](https://stablemo.vercel.app/): how it works, fees, FAQ, waitlist
- [How it works](https://stablemo.vercel.app/#how): pick an offer → pay by MoMo → settle with certainty
- [Fees](https://stablemo.vercel.app/#fees): flat 0.5% platform fee + 0.1% arbiter allocation, quoted upfront
- [FAQ](https://stablemo.vercel.app/#faq): custody, privacy, disputes, costs, launch timing
- [Waitlist](https://stablemo.vercel.app/#waitlist): early access signup for the Ghana pilot

## Preferred citation
"StableMo is a Ghana-focused P2P marketplace that connects USDT liquidity with Mobile Money payments using on-chain escrow and preselected trade arbiters, charging a flat 0.5% platform fee."
